components: root = Col([title, intro, facts, Title("Day by day", "md"), days, Title("Budget", "md"), budget, Title("What it costs", "md"), costs, Title("Getting around", "md"), transit])
intro = Text("Hills, tiled facades and the Tagus: start in **Alfama**, give a day to Belém, then take the train to Sintra.")

days = Grid(@Each(plan, "d", Card([Row([Badge("Day " + d.day, "info"), Text(d.title, "md", null, "semibold")], 2), Text([Icon("map-pin", "sm"), d.place], "sm"), Text(d.text, "sm", "muted")], "soft")), 3, 200, 3)

plan = [{day: 1, title: "Alfama", place: "São Jorge Castle", text: "Climb to the castle, then lunch on grilled sardines."}, {day: 2, title: "Belém", place: "Jerónimos Monastery", text: "The monastery, the tower and pastéis de Belém."}, {day: 3, title: "Sintra", place: "Pena Palace", text: "Train from Rossio; book the palace for 9 AM."}]

budget = Grid([Card([Title("Daily spend", "sm"), Caption("Euros per person"), Chart("bar", spend, "day", ["Food", "Transport", "Sights"], null, true, 220)]), Card([Title("Where it goes", "sm"), Caption("Share of the three days"), Chart("donut", shares, "item", ["cost"], "percent")])], 2, 280, 3)

costs = Table(["Item", "When", "Price", "Book ahead"], [["São Jorge Castle", "Day 1", "€15", Badge("No")], ["Jerónimos Monastery", "Day 2", "€12", Badge("Yes", "warning")], ["Pena Palace", "Day 3", "€20", Badge("Yes", "warning")], ["Tram 28 day pass", "Any", "€7", Badge("No")]])
